properties.description:
Run required type/dependency checks, focused storage/Git/conflict tests and the checkpoint across affected repositories. Verify current data and stable URLs before and after cutover; inspect Activity board, repository and editing UI. Leave the live service running. Document commits, outcomes and remaining limitations without claiming unverified performance improvements.

Completed verification

- Migration preserved 3,224 entities (including 8 definitions), 1,024 relations and 274 evidence files. Current graph URLs remain stable. Ownership follows buildspace definitions and repository dependencies, not displayed names.
- Final build, type-safety, organization and RelationalEngine API-boundary checks passed across the composed repositories. Type check: 1,905 authored files, zero violations.
- DecentralizedPersistence: 15/15 tests passed, covering external edits, stale writes, conflicts, rollback, non-Git storage, optional Git, subscription lifetime and commits preserving unrelated staged/unstaged source changes.
- The complete browser checkpoint exercised 425 cases: 389 initially passed and 36 failed. The failed scenarios were investigated and passed in focused follow-up runs after fixes and fixture corrections. This is not a claim of a clean single full-suite run. Recorded evidence remains in HarnessApp test-results and .harness/checkpoints/run-S68fQH/report.json.
- Planning performance passed 3/3 when run in isolation with unchanged thresholds; the full checkpoint had a timing failure under concurrent load. No general speedup is claimed.
- Live service rebuilt and restarted; migrated task graph, Activity board, Git revision choices, Repositories and regular file editor inspected. Cold startup and initial repository loading remain slow.
- Historical snapshots were preserved in C:/Users/vince/.TheBroccoli/history/planning.git before removing the duplicated generation directories. The new history selector reads repository Git commits on demand; the pre-migration archive is separate and is not integrated into that selector.

Final implementation/verification commits: TheBroccoli 4c46c6a5 (preceded by 3527a5e3, 3e9cfec4, 923c9966, e943f271, c5ec2285, 2fd0c788 and e0443e42); migration commits TheBroccoli c17249fa, BtrTemplate ae06e42b, PersoTemplate 7ba91f04.

HarnessContributor consolidation remains deferred for the agreed joint review of what remains after this extraction.
